title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
abstract: arXiv:2611.21529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algo

translated_title: 无判断的程序：小型语言模型在精确验证器下能学到什么
translated_abstract: 当授权策略阻止智能体的工具调用时，审计日志应当列出导致该决定的事实，且仅限于此。对于定义在可枚举上下文空间上的可执行策略，这个最小充分原因可以被精确计算，因此对解释的评分可以直接对照真实答案，而非其代理指标。我们利用这种精确性来探究：模型能从一个完全没有错误的验证器中学到什么。解释器只能看到一个请求和一个决定，永远看不到策略本身，它拥有三十轮交互机会，可以在其中对修改过的请求调用策略，并询问某个候选事实集合是否充分。前沿模型仅凭这些工具就能在大约一半的情况下找到精确原因，而一句告诉它们缩减答案的提示语使 Haiku 4.5 的成绩从 58% 提升到 75%。在删除算法的 2000 条轨迹上微调的 40 亿参数模型，在其训练所用策略上达到了 92% 的准确率。起决定作用的是教师的类型：在数据量相同的情况下，该算法（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文利用可精确计算的最小充分原因构建了无误差验证器下的策略解释任务，发现前沿模型仅凭查询工具约一半时间能找到精确解释，而仅40亿参数的小模型在2000条算法轨迹上微调后即可达到92%的准确率。
en_tdlr: Using exactly computable minimal sufficient reasons as an error-free verifier, this paper shows frontier models find exact policy explanations about half the time with query tools alone, while a 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% accuracy.
